map.板厚选方法: Choosing a method by plate thickness
map.：薄板 ≤3mm 优先 TIG/电阻焊；中厚板 3–20mm 优先 MIG；厚板: Thin sheet ≤3mm favours TIG/resistance welding; medium and thick plate of 3-20mm favours MIG; thick plate >20mm favours submerged arc; stainless steel and aluminium favour TIG/MIG with argon shielding.
map.：1.5mm 低碳钢板点焊：电极压力约 2–3kN、焊接电流 6–9kA、时间: Spot welding a 1.5mm low carbon steel sheet: electrode force about 2-3kN, welding current 6-9kA, time 8-12 cycles, giving a nugget diameter related to the square root of the sheet thickness.
map.电阻焊和弧焊区别？: What is the difference between resistance welding and arc welding?
map.电阻焊靠接触电阻通电加热加压，无填充金属、快、适合薄板批量；弧焊有电弧与焊丝，适: Resistance welding heats through contact resistance and applies pressure, with no filler metal, so it is fast and suits thin sheet in batches; arc welding uses an arc and a wire, so it suits thick plate and all positions.
map.铝为什么难焊？: Why is aluminium hard to weld?
map.铝氧化膜高熔、导热快、易氢孔，需交流 TIG 破膜或 MIG 脉冲，并严格清理与: Aluminium has a high-melting oxide film, conducts heat quickly and is prone to hydrogen porosity, so it needs AC TIG to break the film or pulsed MIG, with strict cleaning and shielding gas.
